notes.notes:
Store and Library: New arts in the store and in the library were placed.
A new icon has also been added.

Game:

Changes to the menus: some minor changes to the look and feel
were made in the main menu and in the pause menu.

New font: Now the whole game has a much nicer font to look at.

Level changes: some levels were very difficult to complete, so
some small changes have been made to improve this
(it doesn't mean it's easy now).

D-pad: now the D-pad buttons are configured and working.

Checkpoints: now you’ll find checkpoints at all levels, you don’t
need to go back to the beginning when you die.

Some very minor corrections and changes have also been made.

That's it for now, I hope you liked it.

Thank you very much for your attention!!!
